notes.title: 🎉 Exciting News! 🎮
notes.content:
Dear "Buried Alive" Players,

We have some thrilling news to share with you! After solving the issue with the access to source code and in response to a surge of positive feedback and heartfelt requests from players, we have decided to keep Buried Alive alive on Steam!

But that's not all! Stay tuned, as there are more exciting announcements and updates coming your way very soon! 🚀

Best regards,
Mobigrow Team
